knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A new area is a new agreement. The therapist confirms the request, explains the area and draping, and records consent before continuing.
The client decides who is present in the room. The therapist asks the client directly and follows her answer.
The lesson says the client has the right to stop at any time without giving a reason.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate confirm consent before treating a simulated new area, and record it
Assessor observes the candidate drape a simulated client so that only the treated area is exposed at any time
Assessor checks that a simulated client record is stored securely and is not left in the simulated home
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Consent record showing the new area agreed during the simulated session
Record of the client's preference on the door and third-party presence
Photo or observation note of the storage method used for the record
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate treats an area the client has not agreed to
The candidate exposes more of the client's body than the treated area
A third party is allowed in the room against the client's stated wish
